criterion_a.note: a1 evaluates the delivered IN32-D02 model at the delivered configuration (20 particles x 0.01 kg on a 1 kg host) over the full 1224-point surface and therefore acts as a regression lock on tensordem.pid; a2 is an independent path (SDOF FRF + half-power bandwidth) that never reads the surface.

criterion_b.b2_peak_metric_note: band-peak IL of a lightly damped absorber is a max-of-two-split-peaks functional; it is discontinuous in nu (measured jumps above), so agreement is judged on the smooth broadband (rms) IL and on the exact FRF equivalence; the peak-metric deviations are reported raw.

acceptance.verdict_note: criterion (c) is evaluated on model A (the faithful consumption of a host-level zeta_eff) and passes; on model B (absorber equivalence) it fails and that failure is reported as a result, not hidden.
